shortDescription: Allows administration of Keycloak user federations using Keycloak API

options.name: auth_client_id
options.description: OpenID Connect I(client_id) to authenticate to the API with.

options.name: auth_client_secret
options.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with I(auth_client_id) (if required).

options.name: auth_keycloak_url
options.description: URL to the Keycloak instance.

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: auth_realm
options.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

options.name: auth_username
options.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: bind_credential_update_mode
options.description: The value of the config parameter O(config.bindCredential) is redacted in the Keycloak responses. Comparing the redacted value with the desired value always evaluates to not equal. This means the before and desired states are never equal if the parameter is set. Set to V(always) to include O(config.bindCredential) in the comparison of before and desired state. options.name: config
options.description: Dict specifying the configuration options for the provider; the contents differ depending on the value of O(provider_id). Examples are given below for V(ldap), V(kerberos) and V(sssd). It is easiest to obtain valid config values by dumping an already-existing user federation configuration through check-mode in the RV(existing) field. The value V(sssd) has been supported since middleware_automation.keycloak 4.2.0.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API.

options.name: http_agent
options.description: Configures the HTTP User-Agent header.

options.name: id
options.description: The unique ID for this user federation. If left empty, the user federation is searched by its O(name).

options.name: mappers
options.description: A list of dicts defining mappers associated with this Identity Provider.

options.name: name
options.description: Display name of provider when linked in admin console.

options.name: parent_id
options.description: Unique ID for the parent of this user federation. Realm ID is automatically used if left blank.

options.name: provider_id
options.description: Provider for this user federation. Built-in providers are V(ldap), V(kerberos), and V(sssd). Custom user storage providers can also be used.

options.name: provider_type
options.description: Component type for user federation (only supported value is V(org.keycloak.storage.UserStorageProvider)).

options.name: realm
options.description: The Keycloak realm under which this user federation resides.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

options.name: remove_unspecified_mappers
options.description: Remove mappers that are not specified in the configuration for this federation. Set to V(false) to keep mappers that are not listed in O(mappers).

options.name: state
options.description: State of the user federation. On V(present), the user federation is created if it does not yet exist, or updated with the parameters you provide. On V(absent), the user federation is removed if it exists.

options.name: token
options.description: Authentication token for Keycloak API.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production).
